items.caption:
Sleep talking: what do people say in their sleep?
In one Paris sleep lab, 232 adults (mostly patients) were recorded: the top word was 'no', and about 1 in 10 clauses had swearing.

items.caption:
A village kept falling asleep.
From 2013, people in Kalachi, Kazakhstan, fell asleep suddenly, some for days. In 2015 officials blamed gases from a nearby old uranium mine, though the cause is disputed.

items.caption:
Ducks on the edge sleep with one eye open.
In a 1999 study, mallards at the end of a sleeping row kept the outward eye open, and the brain half linked to it stayed awake.
